# What does this PR do ?

Switches the MoE training recipes under `src/megatron/bridge/recipes` for Nemotron 3 / 3.5, Qwen3 / Qwen3.5 (text
and VL) and GLM 5 / 5.2 on GB200 and GB300 from the HybridEP flex dispatcher to the NCCL EP flex dispatcher, in the
same way PR #6171 did for the GB300 perf recipes, and adds the one-GPU-per-rank device binding NCCL EP needs to the
library launch path (`pretrain()` -> `runtime_config_update`).

### Benchmarks (50 steps, mock data, ms per step averaged over iterations 30-45, same allocation per pair)

Before/after = HybridEP recipe on upstream main dec652474 vs this branch. Dispatcher-only = HybridEP with
`moe_use_grouped_tensor=True` vs this branch (isolates NCCL EP from the grouped-tensor change). Speedup =
hep/nep - 1. Container nemo 26.10.rc6 (TE 2.20.2, NCCL 2.31.2), MCore ebab48fc, GB300 NVL72.

| recipe | GPUs | before/after | dispatcher only |
|---|---|---|---|
| nemotron_3_nano_pretrain_8gpu_gb200_bf16 | 8 | -0.9% | +0.8% |
| nemotron_3_5_lightning_sft_openmathinstruct2_packed_tp1 | 8 | +11.5% | +0.4% |
| qwen3_30b_a3b_pretrain_8gpu_gb200_fp8mx | 8 | +11.2% | +5.1% |
| qwen35_text_35b_a3b_pretrain_8gpu_gb200_bf16 | 8 | +49.6% | +8.8% |
| qwen35_vl_35b_a3b_pretrain_8gpu_gb300_fp8mx_library (op-fuser) | 8 | -0.9% | -0.9% (same run) |
| qwen35_vl_35b_a3b_pretrain_16gpu_gb300_bf16 | 16 | +26.9% | +13.1% |
| qwen35_text_35b_a3b_sft_long_context_16gpu_gb200_bf16 | 16 | +5.6% | +5.2% |
| nemotron_3_super_pretrain_64gpu_gb200_bf16 | 64 | +8.1% (+-5%, natural routing) | +4.3% (+-5%) |
| glm52_sft_192gpu_gb200_bf16 | 192 | +2.9% (rc9 container) | +1.3% (+-5% noise)|
| qwen35_vl_397b_a17b_pretrain (64 GPU) | 64 | +7.8% (rc9 container) | n/a (HybridEP + grouped-tensor leg stalled before step 1 and hit the 30-min NCCL watchdog) |
| nemotron_3_ultra_pretrain_256gpu_gb200_bf16_ep16 | 256 | not measurable: both HybridEP and NCCL EP legs fail at step 1 in the TE op-fuser RMSNorm recompute (CUDA invalid device context) on both rc6 (1355971) and rc9 (1478379); dispatcher-independent, recipe-level follow-up | n/a |
